constraints.name: affiliate_documents_review_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'VERIFIED'::text) AND (affiliate_file_id IS NOT NULL) AND (created_by_auth_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING_REVIEW'::text, 'UNDER_REVIEW'::text])) AND (reviewed_by_auth_user_id IS NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['VERIFIED'::text, 'REJECTED'::text, 'REUPLOAD_REQUIRED'::text])) AND (reviewed_by_auth_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.definition: CHECK (((is_archived AND (archived_at IS NOT NULL) AND (archived_by_auth_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(btrim(archive_reason)) >= 8) AND (length(btrim(archive_reason)) <= 500)) AND (archive_previous_status_raw IS NOT NULL)) OR ((NOT is_archived) AND (archived_at IS NULL) AND (archived_by_auth_user_id IS NULL) AND (archive_reason IS NULL) AND (archive_previous_status_raw IS NULL))))

constraints.name: affiliates_restore_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((restored_at IS NULL) AND (restored_by_auth_user_id IS NULL) AND (restore_reason IS NULL)) OR ((restored_at IS NOT NULL) AND (restored_by_auth_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(btrim(restore_reason)) >= 8) AND (length(btrim(restore_reason)) <= 500)))))

constraints.name: affiliates_source_provenance_check

triggers.name: admin_assisted_context
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER admin_assisted_context AFTER INSERT ON public.affiliate_admin_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION admin_support_private.audit_affiliate_write()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_support_private.audit_affiliate_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if exists(select 1 from admin_support_private.context()) then
  insert into public.admin_audit_log(actor_auth_user_id,resource,action,target_id,result,details)
  values(auth.uid(),'affiliate_admin_events',new.action,new.affiliate_id::text,'SUCCESS',jsonb_build_object('event_id',new.event_id));
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

policies.qual:
(has_admin_permission('assets.read'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM affiliate_files af
  WHERE ((af.private_asset_id = private_assets.id) AND (af.affiliate_id = get_effective_affiliate_id()) AND (af.status = 'READY'::text) AND (af.expediente_classification = 'CURRENT_DOCUMENT'::text)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (affiliate_documents d
     LEFT JOIN affiliate_files af ON ((af.id = d.affiliate_file_id)))
  WHERE ((COALESCE(d.private_asset_id, af.private_asset_id) = private_assets.id) AND (d.affiliate_id = get_effective_affiliate_id()) AND (d.status <> 'REJECTED'::text)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (program_catalog_item_assets l
     JOIN program_catalog_items i ON ((i.id = l.item_id)))
  WHERE ((l.private_asset_id = private_assets.id) AND l.enabled AND (i.enabled OR has_admin_permission('program_catalog.read'::text)))))
